text:
rachel: Kicking off three-wave rollout for runtime v2.3 (model artifact v2.3). Order: US -> EU -> APAC. Window 01:30-04:30 UTC. Canary=3% in us-central. APAC will be pinned to v2.2 until quotas confirmed.

deploybot: Queued deploy dpl-3245670000. Canary slice=3% (us-central), warmup=true, preflight=enabled. ETA canary start 4m.

tom: Quick askwhat are warm pool counts? need to know headroom before 25% ratchet.

priya: warm pools: us-central=14 GPUs, us-west=6, eu-west=8, apac-sin=3 (soft quota). Pre-warm ran at 01:10 UTC.

infra-bot: APAC quota ticket #AP-332 created with cloud vendor. Current ETA 5-6h for increase.

rachel: Thanks. Plan: US canary -> hold 12m smoke -> EU canary 3% -> hold 12m -> evaluate APAC. APAC remains pinned to v2.2 for now.

deploybot: Canary started in us-central (3%). dpl-3245670000 logs: /deploys/dpl-3245670000/logs. Instances=3.

ops: smoke checks running: /health p95=48ms, /generate p95=220ms, errors=0.12%, KV warm=79% after 5m.

priYA: (note) KV warm below target 80% - continue monitoring for another 6m before EU.

sre-ana: Rollback triggers set:
- request error_rate > 2% sustained 5m
- p95 latency > 650ms for 5m
- any OOMs on >1 host
If trigger: `deploybot pause dpl-3245670000 && deploybot rollback --id dpl-3245670000 --region <region> --to v2.2` and page on-call.

tom: US KV warmed to 83% at 9m, p95 stable. Green to start EU canary in 8m.

deploybot: EU canary scheduled: dpl-3245670000-eu starting in ~8m, slice=3%, model=v2.3.

ops: EU smoke initial: /generate p95=270ms, errors=0.18%, KV warm=70% (warming).

priya: scaling eu warm +1 GPU to speed cache. Command: `infra scale --region eu-west1 --add 1 --reason warmup`

infra-bot: Scale accepted. New node joining.

ops: EU 10m update: p95=245ms, errors=0.14%, KV warm=85%.

rachel: EU green. Proceed to staged increase: US=25%, EU=25%, APAC pinned. Monitor 20m.

deploybot: Traffic update applied: us=25%, eu=25%, apac=0% pinned. dpl-3245670000 monitoring window 20m.

ops: Note: alert set `p95 > 40% above baseline for 5m` and `error_rate > 1% for 5m`. Also track token-cost spikes when increasing slices.

sre-ana: Thermal fallback: if GPU temps cause throttling reduce concurrency by 20% and batch-size by 1; if >10m then rollback region.

tom: small spike in US: one host returned 500s (~0.35%). isolating host now.

ops: Host us-central-b drained and ejected. Error rate back to 0.11%.

infra-bot: Vendor update: APAC quota ETA moved to ~2h. Outside current window; will plan APAC for next maintenance.

rachel: Decision: complete US/EU to 100% tonight; APAC deferred. Proceeding to full increase if next 20m holds. Everyone OK?

priYA: OK from infra.

sre-ana: OK. Remember to run synthetic eval suite in 30m and verify quality metrics. If output regression flagged, follow manual rollback and ML/product triage.

deploybot: Rollout finished for US+EU. dpl-3245670000: us=100%, eu=100%, apac=0% pinned to v2.2. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/dpl-3245670000/notes

rachel: Thanks team. I'll file APAC follow-up and schedule a shorter retro tomorrow. :tada:
